instructions.primary_message: Wash, peel, and large dice potatoes. Place in a small saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until potatoes can be easily pierced with a fork, 10-12 minutes. Drain and return to saucepan.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Wash, peel, and small dice carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
2 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add onion, carrots, and ground beef. Break apart the beef with a spoon until crumbly. Stirring occasionally, cook until beef is browned and vegetables are tender, 5-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
¾ lb lean ground beef

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Transfer beef and vegetables to a colander and set aside.
Return skillet to stove. Add oil and flour; whisk until smooth. Add broth and Worcestershire. Bring to a simmer.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
1 tbsp gluten-free flour
chicken or vegetable broth
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: Return beef and vegetables to skillet. Add peas, salt, and pepper. Mix well and cook until sauce thickens, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup frozen peas
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil, broth, salt, and pepper to potatoes. Mash until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
chicken or vegetable broth
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place beef and veggie mixture in a bowl or on a plate, top with mashed potatoes, and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!
